name: ModSim Lab
about: The layers of ARCHITECTURE.md, bottom first. The kit core (complex numbers, units, the answer check, Runge–Kutta) is shared by every lab; the core knows the exercises' equations of motion and nothing of the page; the kit (../kit) draws, plays the steps and writes numbers as MATLAB, and knows no law; each lab joins the two for one exercise, with the MATLAB of each step; the app groups the labs under their parts and lays out the page.

layers.name: vendor
layers.why: Temml, the one library: LaTeX to MathML for the kit's math helper (../ARCHITECTURE.md)

layers.name: kit-core
layers.why: Complex numbers, units, the answer check and fixed-step Runge–Kutta every lab shares, pure

layers.name: core
layers.why: The exercises' equations of motion, linear models, closed forms and energies, and the practice checker, pure

layers.name: kit
layers.why: Controls, readouts, charts, the step player and the MATLAB number writer every lab draws with, shared

layers.name: labs
layers.why: One exercise each: animated steps, the source's result beside the lab's, the MATLAB of each step

layers.name: app
layers.why: Reads labs.json, lays out the parts with their labs, and the theme
